dialogues.jp:
「ふぅ……テストが終わった解放感から、今日
　はちょっと動き回りすぎたかな」
dialogues.en:
"Hoo... I sure moved around a lot today. But it was the end
of exams, after all."
dialogues.text:
"Hoo... I sure moved around a lot today. But it was the end
of exams, after all."

dialogues.jp: ちょっと疲れた。
dialogues.en: I was feeling quite tired.
dialogues.text: I was feeling quite tired.

dialogues.jp: コンコン――
dialogues.en: --*knock knock*
dialogues.text: --*knock knock*

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、起きてますか？」
dialogues.en: "Nii-san, are you still awake?"
dialogues.text: "Nii-san, are you still awake?"

dialogues.jp:
そろそろ寝ようかと布団を整えていると、扉が
開いて音夢が入ってくる。
dialogues.en:
While I was arranging my bed to sleep in, Nemu opened the
door from the hallway.
dialogues.text:
While I was arranging my bed to sleep in, Nemu opened the
door from the hallway.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What's up?"
dialogues.text: "What's up?"

dialogues.jp: 夜這いだったら歓迎するぞ。
dialogues.en: A secret visit at night, maybe?
dialogues.text: A secret visit at night, maybe?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「明日から私、風紀委員の仕事があるんだけど、
　朝、ひとりで起きれる？」
dialogues.en:
"Tomorrow, I have to leave early for disciplinary commiittee
work. Can you wake up yourself in the morning?"
dialogues.text:
"Tomorrow, I have to leave early for disciplinary commiittee
work. Can you wake up yourself in the morning?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が心配げに｛き／訊｝いてくる。
dialogues.en: Nemu worriedly posed her question to me.
dialogues.text: Nemu worriedly posed her question to me.

dialogues.jp: 「子供じゃないんだから心配すんなって」
dialogues.en: "You don't have to worry, I'm not a kid anymore."
dialogues.text: "You don't have to worry, I'm not a kid anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だといいんですけどね」
dialogues.en: "Then I guess that's fine."
dialogues.text: "Then I guess that's fine."

dialogues.jp: まったく期待していない顔で答える。
dialogues.en: She answered that way, but her face told otherwise.
dialogues.text: She answered that way, but her face told otherwise.

dialogues.jp:
「お前こそ無理するなよ。仕事って、校門の番
　だろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Don't work yourself too hard either. You'd be manning the
school gate, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Don't work yourself too hard either. You'd be manning the
school gate, right?"

dialogues.jp:
まだまだ、朝の気温は冬だ。じっと突っ立てい
るだけの仕事など、拷問のようなものだ。
dialogues.en:
The weather now is still cold, especially in the morning.
Standing there for hours just for "work" would be torture.
dialogues.text:
The weather now is still cold, especially in the morning.
Standing there for hours just for "work" would be torture.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「心配しなくても、遅刻してきたらばっちり、
　チェックしてあげるから」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry for worrying you, but there has to be someone to
catch all the latecomers."
dialogues.text:
"Sorry for worrying you, but there has to be someone to
catch all the latecomers."

dialogues.jp:
まあ、今までもそんなに問題があった訳じゃな
いし……大丈夫か。
dialogues.en:
That wasn't quite what I meant... oh well, it'd work out in
the end.
dialogues.text:
That wasn't quite what I meant... oh well, it'd work out in
the end.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、おやすみなさい、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, good night, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, good night, nii-san."

dialogues.jp: チリン――
dialogues.en: --*ring*
dialogues.text: --*ring*

dialogues.jp: 鈴を鳴らして、音夢が部屋から出て行く。
dialogues.en: Nemu left my room, her bell leaving a ringing noise echoing.
dialogues.text: Nemu left my room, her bell leaving a ringing noise echoing.

dialogues.jp:
（とりあえず、校門で会ったときに様子を見と
　くか……）
dialogues.en:
"(If I meet her at the school gates late, her reaction would
be...)"
dialogues.text:
"(If I meet her at the school gates late, her reaction would
be...)"

dialogues.jp:
寝坊しないように、目覚ましをセットしておか
なくっちゃな。
dialogues.en:
I had better not sleep in tomorrow; I set my alarm clock to
make sure.
dialogues.text:
I had better not sleep in tomorrow; I set my alarm clock to
make sure.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、勉強を続けた。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、勉強を続けた。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、寝た。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I slept.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I slept.

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢は風紀委員◆
dialogues.en: ◆Nemu, the Disciplinary Committee Member◆
dialogues.text: ◆Nemu, the Disciplinary Committee Member◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢は明日から風紀委員の仕事があるらしい。
朝が俺一人で大丈夫か心配しているみたいだ
が……。
dialogues.en:
Nemu had disciplinary committee work tomorrow. She was fine
with being alone, and not worried at all.
dialogues.text:
Nemu had disciplinary committee work tomorrow. She was fine
with being alone, and not worried at all.

dialogues.jp:
俺の事より、自分の心配をしてもらいたいぞ。
朝はまだまだ冬の寒さだし、風紀委員の仕事は、
校門で立っている事なのだ。
dialogues.en:
She was more worried about me being late for school. The
morning temperature is still cold, and the work would
involve her standing at the school gate for awhile...
dialogues.text:
She was more worried about me being late for school. The
morning temperature is still cold, and the work would
involve her standing at the school gate for awhile...

dialogues.jp: とりあえず、様子を見るようにしよう……。
dialogues.en:
Anyway, I'd better not let her see me coming in late
tomorrow.
dialogues.text:
Anyway, I'd better not let her see me coming in late
tomorrow.
